text_en: When anyone presents a grain offering to the Lord , the offering shall be of choice flour; the worshiper shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it,
text_cn: 若有人愿意给上主奉献素祭为祭品，他的祭品应用细面，倒上油，放上乳香，

text_en: and bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests. After taking from it a handful of the choice flour and oil, with all its frankincense, the priest shall turn this token portion into smoke on the altar, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 拿来交给亚郎的儿子司祭们；司祭取出一把细面和一些油，同所有的乳香，放在祭坛上焚烧，作为中悦上主的馨香火祭，为获得记念。

text_en: And what is left of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons, a most holy part of the offerings by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 剩下的素祭祭品，应归亚郎和他的儿子们，因为是献与上主火祭中的至圣之物。

text_en: When you present a grain offering baked in the oven, it shall be of choice flour: unleavened cakes mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers spread with oil.
text_cn: 如果你愿奉献炉烤的祭品作素祭，应以油调的细面做成的无酵饼，或抹油的无酵薄饼。

text_en: If your offering is grain prepared on a griddle, it shall be of choice flour mixed with oil, unleavened;
text_cn: 若你的祭品是用烤盘做的素祭，该用油调的无酵细面做成，

text_en: break it in pieces, and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
text_cn: 擘(bāi)成块，倒上油：这是素祭。

text_en: If your offering is grain prepared in a pan, it shall be made of choice flour in oil.
text_cn: 若你的祭品是用锅煎的素祭，该用细面和油制成。

text_en: You shall bring to the Lord the grain offering that is prepared in any of these ways; and when it is presented to the priest, he shall take it to the altar.
text_cn: 当你把这样做的素祭祭品献给上主时，应交给司祭带到祭坛前。

text_en: The priest shall remove from the grain offering its token portion and turn this into smoke on the altar, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 司祭由素祭祭品中取出一份，放在祭坛上焚烧，作为中悦上主的馨香火祭，为获得记念。

text_en: And what is left of the grain offering shall be for Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 剩下的素祭祭品，应归亚郎和他的儿子们，因为是献与上主火祭中的至圣之物。

text_en: No grain offering that you bring to the Lord shall be made with leaven, for you must not turn any leaven or honey into smoke as an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 你们献给上主的素祭，都应是无酵做的，因为凡是有酵有蜜的，都不应焚烧作为献给上主的火祭；

text_en: You may bring them to the Lord as an offering of choice products, but they shall not be offered on the altar for a pleasing odor.
text_cn: 但可当作初熟祭品献给上主，只是不可献在祭坛上，当作悦意馨香的祭品。

text_en: You shall not omit from your grain offerings the salt of the covenant with your God; with all your offerings you shall offer salt.
text_cn: 此外，凡你献的素祭祭品都应加上盐，总不可让你的素祭，缺少与你的天主结约的盐；在你的一切祭品上，都应加上盐奉献。

text_en: If you bring a grain offering of first fruits to the Lord , you shall bring as the grain offering of your first fruits coarse new grain from fresh ears, parched with fire.
text_cn: 若你给上主奉献初熟之物作素祭，应奉献火焙的新麦穗，或去壳的新谷粒，当作你初熟之物的素祭，

text_en: You shall add oil to it and lay frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.
text_cn: 再倒上油，放上乳香：这是素祭。

text_en: And the priest shall turn a token portion of it into smoke—some of the coarse grain and oil with all its frankincense; it is an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 司祭取出一些麦粒和油并所有的乳香来焚烧，作为献给上主的火祭，为获得记念。
